_about: The fork's released boards: one entry per board, in the order the flasher lists them.

An entry here is a finished board. fork-release builds every image in its builds (env: a PlatformIO env; idf: the T-Display P4's ESP-IDF build switches), the release notes name it, and the MediaMesh Flasher offers it.
The flasher's file name is wadamesh-<base><suffix of each chosen option, in order>-merged.bin; every combination of options must be one of builds.
scripts/build/boards.py checks all of this in PR CI, and writes the flasher's list (flasher/index.html) from this file.

boards.name: LilyGo T-Deck / T-Deck Plus
boards.boot: Usually connects on its own. If not: switch it off, hold the trackball down, plug in USB (or switch on), then release.

boards.name: Elecrow ThinkNode M9
boards.desc: QWERTY keyboard and d-pad, LR1110 radio.
boards.boot: Usually connects on its own. If not: hold the BOOT button while plugging in USB, then release.

boards.name: LilyGo T-LoRa Pager
boards.desc: QWERTY keyboard and rotary encoder, no touch screen.
boards.boot: Usually connects on its own. If not: hold the BOOT button while plugging in USB, then release. The first USB install resizes the app slots, so it has to be this full install once.

options.label: Radio
options.help: Check the label on the back of your unit. The wrong build leaves the radio dead.

boards.name: Heltec V4 + TFT
boards.desc: Heltec V4 with the 2.4" TFT touch screen, on-screen keyboard.
boards.boot: Usually connects on its own. If not: hold the USER (BOOT) button while plugging in USB, then release. The first install resizes the app slots, so it has to be this full install once.
boards.notes: Heltec V4 and V4-R8 with the TFT

options.label: Model
options.help: V4-R8 is the one with 8 MB of PSRAM, sold with the Expansion Kit V2 (microSD, buzzer, sensors).

boards.name: Seeed Wio Tracker L2
boards.desc: Touch screen, GPS. Pre-release: still being brought up.
boards.boot: Usually connects on its own. If not: hold the BOOT button while plugging in USB, then release. The first install resizes the app slots, so it has to be this full install once.

boards.name: Elecrow CrowPanel Advance
boards.desc: 3.5" or 5" touch screen. Needs an SX1262 module fitted (the 5": in the wireless slot, with the DIP switch set to it).
boards.boot: Usually connects on its own. If not: hold the BOOT button, press RST, then release BOOT. The first install resizes the app slots, so it has to be this full install once.

options.label: Screen
options.help: The size on the box: 3.5" (480x320) or 5" (800x480).

boards.name: LilyGo T-Display P4
boards.desc: Large AMOLED or LCD touch screen, ESP32-C6 for Wi-Fi.
boards.boot: Usually connects on its own. If not: hold BOOT, tap RST, then release BOOT.
boards.notes: T-Display P4 AMOLED or LCD (-lcd; SX1262 or LR2021; -at for units whose C6 still runs the factory ESP-AT)

options.label: Screen
options.help: The box and listing say AMOLED or LCD (TFT). The wrong one leaves the screen blank: flash the other.

options.label: Radio
options.help: SX1262 is the common one; LR2021 units say so on the label.

options.label: Wi-Fi chip firmware
options.help: Current units ship esp-hosted. Pick ESP-AT only for an older unit whose C6 still runs LilyGo's factory ESP-AT.
